acceptanceCriteria: A test with a nil Config either renders status or is refused with a typed error, never a panic
body: Found in V1-1763 lane (PR #1113). TestATRV0107_DispatchStatusShowsContextExhausted first run passed a nil *dispatch.Config and panicked with SIGSEGV in Escalates at internal/tasks/dispatch/config.go:521; the test now passes &dispatch.Config{}. Expected: nil-safe status rendering, or a documented and enforced non-nil contract at the boundary. Actual: panic.
title: dispatch: dispatchStatusValueFor panics on a nil Config (SIGSEGV in Escalates, config.go:521)
